blocker.title: Absence of Automated CI Calibration Gatekeeper, Machine-Readable Quality Policy Enforcer, and Blocking Workflow Check
blocker.root_cause: Prior to G-ML-020, CI/CD pipelines lacked automated enforcement of calibration bounds (ECE <= 0.040, Brier <= 0.080, HCER <= 0.010) and autonomous routing security invariants, allowing degraded models and unverified high-risk executions to merge without verification.
blocker.impact: Autonomous agents operated without automated CI quality guardrails, risking catastrophic production failures from overconfident models and unverified high-risk tool actions.
